lines.en: I head over to Imani's apartment to find her taking some much needed time off and lounging around, watching videos from some sort of social media thing on her phone.
lines.zh: 我去 Imani 的公寓,发现她正休着急需的假,懒洋洋地躺着,用手机看某种社交媒体上的视频。

lines.en: She makes some room on her mattress, which can hardly be called a bed as it's haphazardly thrown onto the floor, and I take my place beside her.
lines.zh: 她在床垫上腾出些位置——那玩意被随手扔在地板上,实在配不上「床」这个称呼——我在她身旁坐下。

lines.en: She comes closer, but I neglect to tell her I'd rather have some space as I see little point in denying any form of company anymore.
lines.zh: 她凑得更近了,但我没有告诉她我宁愿有点空间——因为在我看来,拒绝任何形式的陪伴,已经没什么意义。

lines.en: Our shoulders touch as she begins to include me in her marathon of something she calls doom scrolling. And I quickly find that it effectively kills a lot of time.
lines.zh: 她的肩膀贴上我的,开始把我纳入她那场名为「末日刷屏」的马拉松。我很快发现,它确实能有效杀掉大量时间。

lines.en: So much time, in fact, that it's midnight before I know it. And I'm left with the option to either go home, or spend the night here with her.
lines.zh: 时间多得不知不觉就到了午夜。摆在我面前的选择是:回家,或者留在这里和她过夜。

lines.en: So of course I go home. Because, while I tell myself I'm against denying company, there's still a part of me that's a coward. Or a part of me that wants her to be happy.
lines.zh: 所以,我当然回了家。因为,尽管我告诉自己我不拒绝陪伴,我身上仍有一部分是懦夫。或者有一部分,希望她幸福。

lines.en: And she's been kind and good and useful enough to deserve more than just the shell I can provide her as the person I am now.
lines.zh: 而她一直善良、美好、有用,值得得到的,远不止如今的我所能给她的那副空壳。

lines.en: I would kill to be able to give her more, because a friend alone will not sustain this frantically beating heart and these hands that keep grasping at straws but coming up empty.
lines.zh: 为了能给她更多,我愿意杀人——因为光凭「朋友」,养不活这颗狂跳的心,和这双不停抓着稻草、却总是抓空的手。

lines.en: I want to put another me inside of her.
lines.zh: 我想把另一个我放进她的身体里。

lines.en: I want to bite off her tongue.

lines.zh: Imani 的好感度提升到了 [imani_love]!
